title: Recurrence for the miss probability
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of degree $D>0$, and let $t,s$ be vertices and $k$ a nonnegative integer. The miss probability after $k+1$ steps from $s$ equals $0$ if $s=t$; otherwise it equals the average, over the neighbor slots of $s$, of the miss probability after $k$ steps from the resulting vertex.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite regular multigraph of degree $D>0$
